**Back up first.** Before you install this version, make a backup in Settings › Backup & data.

**Getting ready for Forkcast 2.0**
- This version puts your data and settings in the exact form Forkcast 2.0 uses. Nothing changes on screen, and your log, foods, recipes, weights and settings stay as they are.
- **After updating, make a new backup** in Settings › Backup & data, and keep it until you're on 2.0. Forkcast 2.0 restores backups made by this version or later, not older ones.
- Automatic backup's days now always show the days you picked. If you set it up before choosing days, it keeps the schedule it had (every day, or the one day of the week).
